done_when: Each worker round's brief carries the item's full Done-when, the callers of each changed function and the tests that cover them, and tells the worker to finish all of them before review; close names a missing proof list before the review and the skill tells the coordinator to add it when it commits a fix itself; a review finding that is only a missing proof list or approach record gets one automatic repair round without an owner question; new and existing repos get it on upgrade

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A worker removes a redundant statement from the body of a multiline method such as `ProjectsController.create` at `src/forge/templates/starter/libs/projects/server/src/projects.controller.ts:70`. For a deletion-only hunk, this loop examines the removed statement for a function declaration but never records its enclosing method. The next round’s map therefore omits `create` and its callers and tests. The new test replaces a body line, so it exercises an added line rather than this deletion case.
findings.title: Not done: Include multiline TypeScript methods in the worker brief

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A commit has an empty `Proof list:` followed by a separate `Functional check:` paragraph. `review.commit_paragraph` at `src/forge/review.py:702` captures the rest of the commit message, so this check treats the functional-check text as proof and starts review despite the empty list. The added tests cover an empty heading only when no later paragraph follows it.
findings.title: Not done: Stop before review when the proof list is empty

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A review reports `Gate: proof list` together with a missing-approach note titled `Simpler: Missing approach → record the need, simplest option and reuse`. Forge has already recorded that wording in `.factory/fixes/the-starter-s-browser-motion-test-fails.json:44`. It contains neither `before coding` nor the contiguous phrase `approach record`, so the all-findings check rejects it. Although both findings concern missing records, close reaches the round limit and asks the owner instead of granting the automatic repair round.
findings.title: Not done: Grant the repair round for other missing-record findings

stop.reason: Owner chose one more round on 19 Nov 2026

why: Worker rounds often need 2-4 rounds for selector, assertion or execution-path corrections the first round could have caught, and when the coordinator commits a small fix itself its first review blocks on 'proof list: missing' (measured at a client on 18 Nov 2026: 3 one-file fixes, 20-60 min each)
